selectionBasis: Exclude initial/final holds. Use consecutive moving poses with compatible support phase and body/plate position across the loop boundary. Compare boundary motion as well as pose; do not duplicate an endpoint or synthesize intermediate poses.
pixelPolicy: Existing B3 base 10 colors only. Fixed scale/offset from returned initial reference poses for every selected frame. Keep source motion and intentional spaces between supports. Binary alpha; conservative tiny-component cleanup and enclosed pinhole repair only. No new outlines, gradients, per-frame scaling, body-part replacement or foot pinning.
